input.brief: A vertical 4:5 (1080x1350 px) LinkedIn image. Full-bleed photo-realistic image of a utility-scale solar park in India at golden hour, rows of solar panels stretching to the horizon, warm low sunlight, with clear open sky space at the top of the image. Overlay this exact headline in bold white text in the clear sky area at the top, uppercase, no changes to wording: "INDIA DOESN'T JUST NEED MORE SOLAR CAPACITY. IT NEEDS MORE USABLE SOLAR ENERGY". No other text, logos or elements.
